sections.title: The basic idea
sections.text: An NTC thermistor’s resistance decreases as temperature rises. A calibrated divider voltage is sampled by an ADC and converted to temperature with a resistance–temperature curve.

sections.title: What the device does
sections.text: Convert temperature-dependent sensor readings into a calibrated digital measurement. The Digital Thermometer signal path begins with temperature and leads to display. Between these endpoints, thermistor, signal conditioning, adc, calibration mcu connect the physical system to its digital processing and output.

sections.title: Thermistor

sections.title: The basic idea
sections.text: The main magnetic field creates a small net equilibrium magnetization from nuclear spins. RF pulses tip that magnetization; gradients encode position and receive coils detect the resulting RF signal for image reconstruction. MRI does not use ionizing radiation.

sections.title: What affects the result
sections.text: Only a small population imbalance contributes to net magnetization; the spins do not all align identically. RF excitation and gradients provide the measured and spatially encoded signal.

sections.title: The basic idea

sections.title: What affects the result
